text: Android und IOS lassen sich leider nicht über Accountability Partner verbinden. Ansonsten coole App, die im Alltag hilft.
author: Riah

text: Changing micro habits with this app is working but I would have expected more. You have to collect your old to-dos from each day in the calender by hand, there is no all-time to-do list. The statistics are useless, one curve would make sense, but not one for each emotion.
author: Otto Mops

text: Update3: no more crashes, awesome!- I really like the doing of the app. Though, some important things to improve: statistics got a bit better!habits or routines should be possible to schedule on individual days, like workdays, weekends etc.. - That said, the app is quite intuitive and has the potential to be the best of its kind!
